title: Measurement capsule 0.3: the optional provisions binding
description: Capsule schema csoai.measurement-capsule/0.3 is csoai.measurement-capsule/0.2 plus one optional field, provisions. Each entry pins one provision of the frozen provision manifest (/interop/frozen-provision-hashes.json) by its id, its frozen SHA-256 and the manifest's corpus root. A capsule without the field stays a 0.2 capsule. The binding names a provision; it does not state that the capsule measures what the provision requires, and it is never a compliance determination. This schema checks shape only: that each hash and root are the manifest's is checked by functions/_lib/provisionBinding.ts (checkProvisionBinding).

provision_id.description: CELEX number, a colon, the manifest's own number for the provision (negative numbers are annexes).

relation.description: PREDICATE: the capsule is the output of a deterministic check of one observable the provision names. RELEVANT_TO: the measurement is relevant to the provision and does not test it.
